instruction: Enable dark mode for all GNOME applications by changing the color scheme preference to dark.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling dark mode by setting color-scheme preference to 'prefer-dark' in GNOME settings. Evaluator uses gsettings to verify color-scheme contains 'prefer-dark'. Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement

Getter (cache_file) correctly reads the gsettings output file
Metric (check_list) correctly uses regex pattern matching to search for 'prefer-dark' in the output
Expected value 'prefer-dark' is the correct GNOME setting value for dark mode (GNOME 42+)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires
No state timing issues: gsettings values are persistent and accessible after task completion
Correct parameter handling: metric function properly uses 'rules.get("expect", [])' when expected.type='rule'
